texts.Name: Anton Dziatkovskii
texts.When did your most recent full-time role: N/A - current roles are ongoing: Founder, Palo Alto AI Research Lab (2023-now); Co-Founder, Platinum VC & Incubator (2015-now)
texts.What have you personally built and shipp: A production multi-machine Claude fleet (6 machines), built and operated in public: multi-machine agent consensus (claw-consensus, offline demo + published evals), a self-built AI-native CRM, persistent memory over a 10-year knowledge base (RAG + SQLite), and 100+ automation routines. Also verbatim-citation-gate (MIT) - a zero-token gate that catches fabricated RAG citations. Tools: mainly Claude Code with MCP connectors. 110 public repos: github.com/tonydzi.
texts.What's the highest-impact product or exp: The deal-flow machine at Platinum VC & Incubator, owned end-to-end as co-founder: I designed and wrote our own CRM (roots: 5 years building ERP/CRM on Salesforce and Microsoft Navision at Merlion) with social enrichment, parsing at scale and lead-to-call pipelines. Measurable outcome: 10,000+ founder calls and 2,000+ institutional-investor calls processed, up to 30 operators working in it daily, and it now runs AI-native. Built on top of it: $35M fund under management and a syndicate of 250 VCs/angels.
